Hello [user_name], Thanks for sharing the info! I'm currently testing the app—I’ve connected my [article_no] to the PC and set up my WiFi, everything seems to be working. However, I’m curious about the actual benefit of this app. Who is its target user? Since I can already perform these functions using [product_name] on the PC, and you still need to connect to the PC, I’m not sure of its purpose. In my view, releasing the source code or API would make sense, as [product_name] is a programming device and programmers often need to create solutions for customers. Customers typically want to interact with controls like “Start Pump” or “Stop Heater,” rather than just monitor I/O or variables. What would it cost [company_name] to make the source code available?

Hi, You make a valid point. However, imagine being by the pool and needing to adjust a setting—would you really want to disrupt your downtime for that? I think as an additional feature, the app is quite handy. It supports Dyndns, allows you to change values (if permitted), and displays status updates. But as long as your PC is connected, you probably don’t need it. Best regards
